course_position.stage_name: Consolidation, Fluency, Confidence, and Integrated Review

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: React to a film, article, or event with a balanced opinion and implied attitude.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Two adults discuss something they watched, read, or attended and need more nuance than simple like/dislike.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Summarizing an impression, explaining limits, and recommending or not recommending it.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a film, article, talk, or local event, infer the overall impression, and decide who it would suit.

main_focus.name: balanced evaluation with fördel, nackdel, däremot, and passar för
main_focus.description: Use evaluation language to give a nuanced reaction with contrast and recommendation.
model_examples: En fördel var att den var lätt att följa.
Däremot passar den nog inte för någon som vill ha mycket tempo.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use 3-5 evaluation or contrast phrases naturally, including one recommendation.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use accessible media and review vocabulary without making the lesson academic.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker gives a first impression of something recently watched, read, or attended.
dialogue_shape.middle: They discuss one strength, one limitation, and the implied attitude behind the reaction.
dialogue_shape.ending: They decide whether to recommend it and for whom.

target_complexity.repetition: evaluation frames should support a balanced opinion

focus: the overall impression of the film, article, or event
the contrast between the strength and limitation
the recommendation and who it would suit

sentence_focus: one sentence with Mitt intryck var att
one recommendation sentence with passar för
